recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future problem is found with the caseSensitive value for an individual V2 table, handle it through THO/UTG rather than duplicating V2 case-sensitivity guidance in FHIR core.
issue_request: FHIR-14567 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for FHIR-core CodeSystem/V2 terminology content. It reported that FHIR's V2 CodeSystem representations were using CodeSystem.caseSensitive=false while the old external-code-system text asserted that Version 2 codes were case sensitive; the final resolution was to state that V2 code systems may or may not be case sensitive and to carry the correct case from the v2 Standard into UTG.
initial_application: Upstream git-svn commit 079c8d6557f42f597b18fd2c43ea84b63155dedf, matching Jira's svn revision 14630 comment, added a note saying V2 code systems may or may not be case sensitive and stopped the V2 importer from forcing all generated V2 CodeSystem.caseSensitive values to false or true.
additional_context: Vocab WG minutes from 2018-06-14 record the same 10-0-0 motion captured in Jira. Later UTG migration history removed source/v2 and the V2/V3 generated tabs from the core Code Systems page. Current active core terminology pages direct authoritative external terminology use to terminology.hl7.org and link HL7 V2 Tables to THO. A copied tools/tx/v2 template still contains the historical may-or-may-not note, but repository search found no current build reference to tools/tx/v2.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current core source no longer says that Version 2 codes are always case sensitive and does not publish the old core-hosted V2 CodeSystem resources with stale caseSensitive values; V2 CodeSystem case-sensitivity details now live in THO/UTG.
